decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Stinkweed Imp, Golgari Thug, and Golgari Grave-Troll, while utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to help dredge through the deck. This allows the player to bring back powerful creatures like Ichorid and Prized Amalgam from the graveyard, creating a powerful board presence. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap to protect the combo and counter opponent's plays, making it a strong and fast-paced combo deck in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on manipulating the opponent's plays and resources while having a strong control over the game. The key strategy involves using a combination of counter spells, removal, and mana denial to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of a companion card adds an additional layer of consistency and flexibility to the deck. By efficiently managing resources and consistently disrupting the opponent's strategy, this Esper Control deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Oath of Druids to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier while controlling the game with counterspells and disruption. It also has access to powerful cards like Show and Tell to cheat out big threats. The deck has a good mix of creatures, spells, and mana acceleration to ensure a strong board presence and the ability to dictate the pace of the game. The inclusion of cards like Gaea's Blessing and Boseiju, Who Endures helps to protect against opposing disruption and ensure consistency in executing its game plan.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach to create powerful combos by repeatedly casting cheap spells from the graveyard. Key cards like Ancestral Recall, Brain Freeze, and Tinker are used to set up game-winning plays. The deck also includes powerful mana acceleration in the form of Black Lotus, Moxen, and Tolarian Academy to quickly cast spells and overwhelm opponents. Counterspells like Force of Will and disruption cards like Hullbreacher and Dack Fayden help protect the combo and disrupt opponents' strategies. The strategy is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to win the game.

The deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the game while still applying pressure to the opponent. Utilizing a mix of powerful spells and mana sources, it aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while deploying threats such as Oko, Thief of Crowns and Deathrite Shaman. The deck also includes cards like Abrupt Decay, Force of Will, and Fatal Push to deal with challenges presented by the opponent. By combining aggressive creatures with disruption, the deck looks to overwhelm opponents and secure victory in a fast-paced format like Vintage 1 vs 1.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly and efficiently through cards like Grim Monolith and Tolarian Academy, along with mana artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen. The goal is to assemble the Time Vault and Voltaic Key combo to take extra turns, while also utilizing Paradoxical Outcome to draw cards and generate even more mana. With the ability to disrupt opponents with Force of Will and other control elements, the deck aims to execute its combo quickly and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and hate cards to disrupt your opponent's strategy. It utilizes cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to slow down your opponent, while also including cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine to disrupt their mana base. Anointed Peacekeeper and White Plume Adventurer provide additional disruption, while Witch Enchanter and March of Otherworldly Light offer card advantage and ways to close out the game quickly. The deck aims to control the board and outpace the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures with disruptive abilities, aiming to slow down and disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure. The combination of Hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria with disruptive artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Wasteland can quickly disrupt the opponent's mana base and prevent them from executing their strategy effectively. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Seasoned Dungeoneer and Witch Enchanter to help maintain a steady stream of threats and disruption.

The deck focuses on using Coveted Jewel as a key piece of the combo, along with cards like Tinker, Time Vault, and Paradoxical Outcome to generate mana and draw cards efficiently. By combining acceleration from artifacts like Moxen and Mishra's Workshop with control elements like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor, the deck aims to assemble powerful synergies and outvalue opponents through card advantage and efficient threats like Karn, the Great Creator. Ultimately, the goal is to generate a decisive advantage and set up a win condition through the interactions of the combo pieces.

The deck utilizes the powerful combo potential of Underworld Breach, alongside cards like Brain Freeze and LED, to create a quick win condition. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Dack Fayden to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently while also being able to interact with the opponent's spells. The deck is designed to be a high-risk, high-reward strategy that can win the game in a single explosive turn if all the pieces come together.

This deck focuses on using disruptive spells and creatures to control the game, while leveraging powerful card advantage engines like Ancestral Recall, Dig Through Time, and Treasure Cruise. The deck also includes efficient removal in Swords to Plowshares and counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its game plan. With the addition of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, this Esper Control deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format, utilizing a mix of disruptive creatures and powerful spells to dominate the game.

The central focus of this deck revolves around utilizing the Oath of Druids card to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes disruptive control elements such as Show and Tell, Force of Will, and Oko, Thief of Crowns to manipulate the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By effectively balancing control elements with powerful creature cheat mechanics, this deck aims to control the game tempo and overwhelm opponents with its threats, ultimately securing victory through strategic play and efficiency.

This deck aims to use Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast powerful spells from the graveyard, combining fast mana, card draw, and disruption to assemble a combo win condition. The deck includes tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor to find key pieces quickly, as well as powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Tinker. Force of Will and Hullbreacher provide disruption while cards like Ponder and Brainstorm help to dig for combo pieces. The deck is designed to be fast and explosive, aiming to win the game quickly through powerful combos.

The deck focuses on using hatebears and aggro creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures. It uses mana acceleration and disruptive elements like Chancellor of the Annex and Archon of Emeria to slow down the opponent, while also utilizing powerful cards like Anointed Peacekeeper and Seasoned Dungeoneer to control the board. The deck also includes hate cards like Chalice of the Void and Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while keeping them off balance with disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on applying pressure with efficient creatures like Deathrite Shaman, Leovold, and Collector Ouphe while disrupting opponents with cards like Force of Will and Abrupt Decay. It also has access to powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to gain card advantage and tempo. The mana base is built to support the deck's three-color identity while also including disruptive lands like Wasteland and Strip Mine. Overall, the deck aims to control the game early on and slowly grind out opponents with its versatile threats and answers.

This deck focuses on utilizing a mix of powerful control spells, like Force of Will and Fatal Push, along with disruptive cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes cards like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to draw into more answers and stay ahead in card advantage. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value and recursion, making this Dimir Control deck a strong and versatile option in Vintage 1 vs 1 matches.
